description:
The Bulkley Valley is known for excellent snow conditions and a lengthy ski season due to its elevation and prime location in a snowbelt area between BC's cold interior and damp coastal climates.

The Bulkley Valley Nordic Centre has a lodge, waxing facilites and 52 kilometres of cross country ski trails, groomed for both classic and skating. 11 km of the trails are dog friendly.

Trails in effect.
More info found here: https://bvnordic.ca/trails-and-facilities/
directions: On Highway 16, turn left at first set of lights on to Tatlow Road (at Toyota dealer), turn right onto Pacific Street at LB Paving, turn Left on Dahlie Road, cross over railway overpass. Follow the hard left turn on to Hudson Bay Mountain Road (follow skier signs), continue up Hudson Bay Mountain Road. The BV Nordic Centre is the second right after the switchbacks and has a large Bulkley Valley Nordic Centre sign at the entrance.
